Bill.BriefDescription: Creating a global Asia institute within the Henry M. Jackson School of International Studies.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to establishing a global Asia institute; adding anew section to chapter 28B.20 RCW; creating a new section; and makingan appropriation.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The legislature finds that Asia and itsinteractions with the rest of the world are transforming the way theworld works in the twentyfirst century. The legislature further findsthat trade, finance, technology, and global influence and institutionsare all areas in which China, India, and other Asian states are in theprocess of reshaping the nature of the international system, and thatWashington state is uniquely situated to contribute to enhanceinteractions between the United States and Asia. The legislatureintends to establish a global Asia institute at the University ofWashington.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 28B.20 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: A global Asia institute is created within the Henry M. JacksonSchool of International Studies. The mission of the institute is to p. 1 SB 5177promote the understanding of Asia and its interactions with Washingtonstate and the world. The institute shall host visiting scholars andpolicymakers, sponsor programs and learning initiatives, engage incollaborative research projects, and facilitate broader understandingand cooperation between the state of Washington and Asia throughgeneral public programs and targeted collaborations with specificcommunities in the state.

The sum of two million dollars, or as muchthereof as may be necessary, is appropriated for the fiscal year endingJune 30, 2010, from the general fund to the higher educationcoordinating board for the purposes of this act.
